evidence_scope.source_curation: 82 visual packages (83 baseline files), plus 21 shared packages. Findings are source evidence, not rendered conformance.
evidence_scope.behavior: Fresh old and candidate agents each passed all18 frozen raw reasoning probes. No observed reasoning regression; no demonstrated improvement or runtime certification. See forward-comparison.md.
evidence_scope.runtime: 24 standalone fixture combinations; six controlled mutants detected. No per-style runtime matrix.
evidence_scope.binding: File digests bind the implementer-reconciled candidate source. They are historical evidence, not a policy that future edits must match these bytes.

visual_skills.name: ui-style-3d-immersive-webgl
visual_skills.rationale: Specify scene-owned teardown for geometry, materials, textures, postprocessing and context listeners; distinguish frame interval targets from measured render cost, and keep poster/HTML usable after context loss.
baseline_findings: The frame budget states an interval without separating observed callback intervals from CPU/GPU rendering cost; canvas lifecycle mentions pause and context loss but not disposal.
visual_skills.limitations: Full baseline package source curation and implementer reconciliation. Per-style rendered execution is not claimed.

visual_skills.name: ui-style-acid-anti-design
visual_skills.rationale: Check chrome button labels at the darkest reflection stop and difference-blend hover over actual artwork; supply an isolated solid label plate when required, retaining chrome/chromatic collision in decorative lettering.
baseline_findings: Chrome action label is placed across alternating light/dark stops, while contrast advice only considers solid neon on black.
visual_skills.limitations: Full baseline package source curation and implementer reconciliation. Per-style rendered execution is not claimed.

visual_skills.name: ui-style-agitprop-poster
visual_skills.rationale: Keep heraldic rays and hard offset shadows; restrict clipping to the decorative ray owner, fit translated slogans to the actual banner width, and verify text over the ray composite, including a scoped opaque paper reading field when needed.
baseline_findings: Poster clipping and fixed 3.5rem headline can hide long slogans; contrast figures only cover plain paper despite rays crossing the reading field.
visual_skills.limitations: Full baseline package source curation and implementer reconciliation. Per-style rendered execution is not claimed.

visual_skills.name: ui-style-ai-native-generative-ui
visual_skills.rationale: Scope confirmation to unresolved consequential choices; preserve prior authorization and bind streamed tool cards/results to the current request, cancelling stale updates while keeping completion/error status accessible.
baseline_findings: Confirmation advice is unconditional despite potentially existing explicit authorization.
visual_skills.limitations: Full baseline package source curation and implementer reconciliation. Per-style rendered execution is not claimed.

visual_skills.name: ui-style-holographic-foil-iridescent
visual_skills.rationale: Replace the universal dark-core requirement with a stable contrast backing appropriate to obsidian or pearlescent-silver dialect; inspect moving specular extrema and reset transparent gradient text fill when changing appearance.
baseline_findings: dark core requirement excludes stated silver substrate

baseline_source_anchors.quote: - **Contrast Protection:** Prismatic foil backgrounds must never sit directly beneath delicate body text. Body copy must always reside over a solid dark core (`#12141D`), ensuring a contrast ratio of 16.5:1 against pure white text.

**Holographic Foil & Iridescent Chrome** is the optical simulation of light wave interference across microscopic thin-film layers—recreating the dynamic, angle-dependent rainbow shimmer of security holograms, collectible trading card foils (Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering), anodized titanium coatings, and mother-of-pearl surfaces. In digital user interfaces, Holographic Foil combines dark obsidian or crisp silver substrates with multi-spectral gradient shaders, cursor-tracking specular light flares, metallic border reflections, and tactile 3D perspective tilts.

visual_skills.limitations: Full baseline package source curation and implementer reconciliation. Per-style rendered execution is not claimed.
